worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.summary: Shakes out a coat of thin quills that fly at the target one after another with homing: each pierces once and stays embedded. The more quills stick, the heavier the drag (slowness). Barbed quills are fewer, harder and last longer; rapid quills are many and quick to fire.
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.use.0: A burst of homing quills that always find the target at mid-long range
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.use.1: Slow a target down with embedded quills and pin it in place
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.use.2: Light per-quill and quick to fire, good for steady pressure
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.description: Each quill deals %1$s physical damage, and the burst fires %2$s quills (2-5 natively, set by the user's data).
Quills fire every %1$s at %2$s blocks/tick and turn up to %4$s° per tick toward a target within %3$s blocks.
Each quill has a %1$s block hit radius; up to %2$s quills can stick, each keeping the slow for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.barbed.on: Barbed quills: per-quill power x1.25, stick duration x1.5 and spread x0.7; costs quills capped at 3, quill speed x0.92, interval +1 tick, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.barbed.off: Rapid quills: up to 5 quills, interval -1 tick and a faster quill speed; costs per-quill power x0.9, a shorter stick and spread x1.15.
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-quill power rises to %2$s and the burst grows to %3$s quills.
worldcombat.skill.pinmissile.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-quill power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
On: per-quill power x1.25, stick duration x1.5 and spread x0.7 for pinning a target down; costs quills capped at 3, quill speed x0.92, interval +1 tick, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off (rapid quills): up to 5 quills, a tighter interval and a faster quill speed, at the cost of per-quill power x0.9, a shorter stick and spread x1.15.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: targets already carrying quills rank lower so the quills go to foes not yet slowed; off: all targets score the same.
